source: Massachusetts DOR 2026 withholding guide (Form M-4, reproduced in NFC bulletin NFC-26-1769797447, eff. pay period 10-2026): 5% flat plus 4% surtax over $1,107,750 (modeled as a 9% top bracket); exemptions modeled as $3,400 + $1,000/allowance (exact for >=1 exemption; a 0-allowance election over-deducts $3,400 — CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTION); no withholding under $8,000/yr when >=1 exemption (encoded as lowIncomeExemption). The <=$2,000 FICA/retirement deduction and $120 HoH / $110 blind credits are not modeled.
